#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

int rem(const vector<int>& arr, int ind, int val) {
    int cnt = 0;
    for (int i = ind; i < (int)arr.size() && arr[i] < val; i++)
        cnt++;
    return cnt;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    string s;
    cin >> s;
    vector<int> V, K, X;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        if (s[i] == 'V') V.push_back(i);
        else if (s[i] == 'K') K.push_back(i);
        else X.push_back(i);
    }

    const long long INF = LLONG_MAX;
    vector<vector<vector<vector<long long>>>> dp(
        n + 1, vector<vector<vector<long long>>>(
            n + 1, vector<vector<long long>>(
                n + 1, vector<long long>(2, INF)
            )
        )
    );

    dp[0][0][0][0] = 0;

    for (int v = 0; v <= (int)V.size(); v++) {
        for (int k = 0; k <= (int)K.size(); k++) {
            for (int x = 0; x <= (int)X.size(); x++) {
                for (int t = 0; t < 2; t++) {
                    long long cur = dp[v][k][x][t];
                    if (cur == INF) continue;

                    if (v < (int)V.size()) {
                        int vv = V[v];
                        int m1 = rem(V, v, vv) + rem(K, k, vv) + rem(X, x, vv);
                        if (dp[v + 1][k][x][1] > cur + m1)
                            dp[v + 1][k][x][1] = cur + m1;
                    }
                    if (k < (int)K.size() && t == 0) {
                        int kk = K[k];
                        int m2 = rem(V, v, kk) + rem(K, k, kk) + rem(X, x, kk);
                        if (dp[v][k + 1][x][0] > cur + m2)
                            dp[v][k + 1][x][0] = cur + m2;
                    }
                    if (x < (int)X.size()) {
                        int xx = X[x];
                        int m3 = rem(V, v, xx) + rem(K, k, xx) + rem(X, x, xx);
                        if (dp[v][k][x + 1][0] > cur + m3)
                            dp[v][k][x + 1][0] = cur + m3;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    long long ret = LLONG_MAX;
    for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
        if (dp[(int)V.size()][(int)K.size()][(int)X.size()][i] < ret)
            ret = dp[(int)V.size()][(int)K.size()][(int)X.size()][i];
    }
    cout << ret << "\n";

    return 0;
}
